stdout:
Transition a live broadcast. Use this tool to change the status of a live broadcast (e.g., go live, end broadcast).

Usage:
  yutu liveBroadcast transition [flags]

Examples:
# Transition a broadcast to live
yutu liveBroadcast transition --ids broadcast123 --broadcastStatus live
# End a broadcast
yutu liveBroadcast transition --ids broadcast123 --broadcastStatus complete

Flags:
  -s, --broadcastStatus string                 Broadcast status to transition to (testing, live, complete)
  -h, --help                                   help for transition
  -i, --ids strings                            IDs of the broadcasts to transition
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,status])
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
